sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiǎoxīn guò mǎlù.
sentences.english: Please cross the road carefully.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen guòle nà zuò qiáo.
sentences.english: We passed that bridge.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huāle liǎng bǎi kuài qián.
sentences.english: I spent two hundred yuan.

sentences.pinyin: Tā huā hěn duō shíjiān xuéxí.
sentences.english: He spends a lot of time studying.

sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē huā hěn piàoliang.
sentences.english: These flowers are very beautiful.

sentences.pinyin: Māma zài huāyuán lǐ zhòng huā.
sentences.english: Mum plants flowers in the garden.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān huán nǐ de shū.
sentences.english: I will return your book tomorrow.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ qián huán gěi wǒ le.
sentences.english: He returned the money to me.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān jīngguò zhège gōngyuán.
sentences.english: I pass through this park every day.

sentences.chinese: 经过三年的学习，他说得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò sān nián de xuéxí, tā shuō de hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: After three years of study, he speaks very well.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen de jīnglǐ hěn máng.
sentences.english: Our manager is very busy.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dāng yínháng jīnglǐ.
sentences.english: He wants to be a bank manager.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ děngle hěn jiǔ ma?
sentences.english: Did you wait a long time?

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen hǎojiǔ méi jiànmiàn le.
sentences.english: We have not seen each other for a long time.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn jiù le.
sentences.english: This book is very old.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng mǎi jiù chē.
sentences.english: He does not want to buy a used car.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège jùzi hěn cháng.
sentences.english: This sentence is very long.

sentences.chinese: 请用这个词造一个句子。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng yòng zhège cí zào yí ge jùzi.
sentences.english: Please make a sentence with this word.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng qù Zhōngguó xuéxí.
sentences.english: I decided to go to China to study.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge zhòngyào de juédìng.
sentences.english: This is an important decision.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hěn kě, xiǎng hē shuǐ.
sentences.english: I am thirsty and want to drink water.

sentences.pinyin: Pǎobù yǐhòu tā juéde hěn kě.
sentences.english: After running he felt very thirsty.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo māo hěn kě’ài.
sentences.english: This kitten is very cute.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiào qǐlái tèbié kě’ài.
sentences.english: She looks especially lovely when she smiles.

sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài shì sān diǎn yí kè.
sentences.english: It is a quarter past three now.

sentences.pinyin: Nà yí kè wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: At that moment I was very happy.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān jiā lǐ láile kèrén.
sentences.english: Guests came to our home today.

sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán duì kèrén hěn kèqi.
sentences.english: The waiter is very polite to the guests.

sentences.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu kōngtiáo.
sentences.english: There is an air conditioner in the room.

sentences.pinyin: Tiān tài rè le, qǐng kāi kōngtiáo.
sentences.english: It is too hot, please turn on the air conditioner.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng zhāngkāi kǒu.
sentences.english: Please open your mouth.

sentences.pinyin: Tā jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
sentences.english: There are five people in his family.

sentences.pinyin: Háizi kūle qǐlái.
sentences.english: The child started to cry.

sentences.pinyin: Bié kū, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo de.
sentences.english: Do not cry, everything will be fine.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kùzi tài cháng le.
sentences.english: These trousers are too long.

sentences.chinese: 他买了一条黑色的裤子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎile yì tiáo hēisè de kùzi.
sentences.english: He bought a pair of black trousers.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ huì yòng kuàizi chīfàn.
sentences.english: I can eat with chopsticks.

sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yì shuāng kuàizi.
sentences.english: A pair of chopsticks is lying on the table.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānkōng hěn lán.
sentences.english: The sky is very blue today.

sentences.chinese: 她穿着一件蓝色的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuānzhe yí jiàn lánsè de yīfu.
sentences.english: She is wearing a blue piece of clothing.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de yéye yǐjīng hěn lǎo le.
sentences.english: My grandfather is already very old.

sentences.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ de lǎo péngyou.
sentences.english: He is an old friend of mine.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zuótiān líkāile Běijīng.
sentences.english: He left Beijing yesterday.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng búyào líkāi zhèlǐ.
sentences.english: Please do not leave here.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì gěi nǐ de lǐwù.
sentences.english: This is a gift for you.

sentences.chinese: 他收到了很多生日礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shōudàole hěn duō shēngrì lǐwù.
sentences.english: He received many birthday gifts.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan xuéxí Zhōngguó lìshǐ.
sentences.english: I like studying Chinese history.

sentences.chinese: 这座城市有很长的历史。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu hěn cháng de lìshǐ.
sentences.english: This city has a very long history.

sentences.pinyin: Tā de liǎn hóng le.
sentences.english: His face turned red.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng xiān xǐ liǎn.
sentences.english: Please wash your face first.
